title: Dominoes
short_description: Calm, classic 3D dominoes — ivory double-six tiles on a warm felt table. Match the pips, work the line, empty your hand.
description: A cozy, unhurried game of draw dominoes rendered in clean 3D. The full double-six set: 28 ivory tiles, seven to a hand. Match a pip end onto either open end of the snaking line; when you can't play, draw from the boneyard until you can. First to empty their hand wins the round — and if the game blocks up, the lightest hand takes it. Play a thoughtful AI across four skill levels on a warm felt table under soft light, with gentle piano. Left-click a tile, then a highlighted open end.
controls_keyboard: Left-click a tile to select · click a highlighted open end to play · click the boneyard to draw when stuck · Right-drag rotate camera · scroll zoom · Esc pause · F3 debug
